info.title: Final Fantasy VII: Timeline Analyzer API
info.description: Read-only access to the Timeline Analyzer's dataset: how the 1997 original, Remake, INTERmission and Rebirth present the same events, characters and places. Title codes: `og`, `remake`, `intermission`, `rebirth`.

get.summary: Whether the API and its database are up
Titles, original segments, arcs, eras and worlds
get.description: Everything needed to label and lay out the rest of the data. It changes only when the dataset is redeployed.

coverage.description: The original segments this title retells; null if it retells none.

get.summary: List entities, optionally one kind or only those a title shows

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Only entities this title shows.

get.summary: One entity: its appearances in every title, differences and relationships

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID, e.g. `character_cloud_strife`.

appearances.description: One per title and world, in release order.

label.description: Read from this entity's side, e.g. `took part in` or `killed by`.

sources.description: Where in the titles to look.

openQuestions.description: Research questions about this entity (facts awaiting a stronger check, gaps).

get.summary: Events in in-universe order, with how each title shows them
get.description: Year 0 is the year the main story begins; earlier years are negative. Events sort by (earliest year, seq, id). Only events shown in at least one of `titles` are returned, each with its appearances in those titles.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

start.description: This title's own time, when it differs.

get.summary: What a title shows, in the order the player sees it
How the chosen titles present one entity, side by side

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID, e.g. `character_cloud_strife`.

isNew.description: Appears in the Remake series but not in the original.

changed.description: A documented difference targets this title.

differences.description: Only those with both sides among the compared titles.

label.description: Read from this entity's side, e.g. `took part in` or `killed by`.

applicable.description: Compared titles that show both ends of the relationship — the only titles that could establish it.

get.summary: Every documented difference between the chosen titles
get.description: Events come first, in in-universe order; then other entities by name.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

get.summary: Structure of the whole relationship graph: groups and degree centrality

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship categories (`structural,event,causal`). Defaults to all.

components.description: Groups of entities connected to each other, largest first.

degree.description: Distinct entities it's directly related to.

centrality.description: Degree centrality, highest first — a dataset metric, not a ranking of characters.

get.summary: The strongest chain of relationships between two entities
get.description: Weighted shortest path (docs/model/relationships.md §6): family, killings, causes and experiments are strong links; membership and residence are weak. Use `avoid` to route around large hubs.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: An entity ID, e.g. `character_cloud_strife`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: An entity ID, e.g. `character_cloud_strife`.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship categories (`structural,event,causal`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Comma-separated entity IDs to leave out, e.g. to find a path that avoids them.

cost.description: Sum of the weights along the path.

label.description: Read from source to target, e.g. `took part in`.

weight.description: Cost in shortest-path search; lower is a stronger link.

get.summary: An entity's neighbourhood in the relationship graph
get.description: Every entity within `depth` relationships of `id`, and the relationships among them, following only relationships that one of `titles` establishes, in the chosen `categories`.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationship categories (`structural,event,causal`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID, e.g. `character_cloud_strife`.

label.description: Read from source to target, e.g. `took part in`.

weight.description: Cost in shortest-path search; lower is a stronger link.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

start.description: Earliest in-universe year; 0 is the year the story begins.

get.summary: Where the chosen titles — and optionally worlds — part ways around an event
get.description: Events before the pivot form the trunk; from the pivot on, each title (and, with `worlds=true`, each other world it shows) is a branch. Each station is marked relative to the other branches: shared, changed, only here, not yet retold, omitted, not yet reached or undocumented.

parameters.name: titles
parameters.description: Comma-separated title codes (`og,remake,intermission,rebirth`). Defaults to all.

parameters.name: worlds
parameters.description: Add other worlds as branches.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An entity ID, e.g. `character_cloud_strife`.

start.description: Earliest in-universe year; 0 is the year the story begins.
Earliest in-universe year; 0 is the year the story begins.

marking.description: How this branch shows the event, relative to the other branches.

missingIn.description: Branches (`title/world`) that cover this part of the story but don't show it.

stations.description: One per branch, in the order of `branches`; null if that branch doesn't show it.

trunk.description: Events before the pivot: the common history.

start.description: Earliest in-universe year; 0 is the year the story begins.

missingIn.description: Branches (`title/world`) that cover this part of the story but don't show it.

stations.description: One per branch, in the order of `branches`; null if that branch doesn't show it.

events.description: The pivot and everything after it, per branch.

sources.description: Where in the titles to look.

interpretations.description: Facts that are inferred or ambiguous, with the notes that explain them.

get.summary: Find entities by name, summary or connection
get.description: Every word must match the entity's names or aliases (typos tolerated), its summary, how a title presents it, or the name of an entity it's related to. Exact and prefix name matches rank first.

detail.description: The matched name, the title code, or the connected entity's name.
